heroDefense._about: Every hero's defense and resist (after levels, before items) is raised by this percent.

heroAttack._about: Every hero's attack (after levels, before items) is raised by this percent (user, session 25: +15% hero damage overall).

heroDanger._about: How a hero in danger looks (BattleScene.drawDangerGlow / heroFell). Low health: below lowHpPercent a soft red glow rises from the bottom edge of the screen under that hero, stronger the lower its health, pulsing slowly (pulseMs). Death: the whole screen pulses red (deathFlash*: colour, top alpha, in/out ms) with the heroDeath sound (a low bell toll, sounds.json), a white flash, the hero tips over (fallMs), lies there lieMs, then POOF: a cloud of smoke (poof*) and the body is replaced by a tombstone, '<NAME> FELL' shows over it (text*) and its column of the glow flares (fellGlowMs).

deathSave._about: Once per run per hero: the first hit that would kill the hero only does this percent of its damage. If that is still enough to kill, the hero dies anyway (the save is used up either way).

minions._about: Minion rules (D4b). upkeep: while a hero's MINION ITEMS have live minions the holder pays this per minion item (percent of the level stat, like item effects; hero passives like the Necromancer's skeletons cost nothing). revivalFloors: a dead greater minion comes back after this many floors are cleared. copyStatBonus: each extra copy of a greater-minion item adds this share of its health and attack (no second minion). itemWeakCap: the shared cap of weak minions from a hero's items. upkeepWeakScale: weak spawner items cost this much of the full upkeep (greater = full). rangedTargetWeight: in an enemy's random target pick a RANGED minion counts as this much of a normal target (user: half as often). Boosters (Bone Charm, Overseer's Whistle, Grave Dust, Necro Crown) cost nothing and reach every minion.

books._about: Skill book limits per skill (pages in skillBooks.json): stat pages may repeat, a modifier only once per skill; a new modifier on a full skill replaces one the player picks.

skillWindUp._about: Skills wind up before they go off (castMs per skill in skills.json, else defaultCastMs). The skill goes on cooldown when tapped; stunned, frozen or silenced during the wind-up = the skill is lost (still on cooldown). No basic attacks and no walking while winding up.

gainText._about: The name of a new item / skill book page over the hero who got it (BattleScene.gainText): one fixed pixel size, never scaled, abovePx over the health bar (clear of the icon pop), fades in sliding up, holds, rises and fades. The item's icon pops up too (itemFx.json iconPop).

skillFx._about: How a skill looks when it goes off (C2), so it is clearly different from a normal hit: the caster flashes in the skill colour, a ring bursts (at the target for attack skills, at the caster for support), a name banner, bigger coloured damage numbers, and attack skills shake the screen with a tiny hit-stop.

charge._about: The CHARGE beat: skill id (a rotation spell: 'skillId:SHORT') -> recipe in src/systems/skillFx.js / heroLooks.js that plays on the hero during the wind-up (castMs). An object { recipe, tremble } also trembles the hero side to side (tremble = px at the end of the wind-up).

look._about: HERO SKILL LOOKS v2 (heroLooks.js, user-approved demo): per skill id (rotation spell 'skillId:SHORT') WHEN the look hits and how the scene plays it. hitMs = the moment it lands: the skill's damage numbers, heals and kills WAIT for it (only the drawing waits, the rules are unchanged), + staggerMs per target in the cast's own target order. At the hit: shakeMs/shakeIntensity, stopMs (hit-stop) and the hit enemies jitter (jitterPx/jitterMs). move: recoil (px > 0 = rocks back from the target, < 0 = steps in). leap: Savage Leap's slam (up/hold/back ms, liftPx, share of the way, knockPx on the enemies in the landing area). allHit = the look draws the cast's own targets. targets 'squad' = the look gets the whole squad. radius: 'area' | 'landSplash' | 'holyNova' (the skill's own radius). swallow = projectile kinds the look already draws. aim = the look gets where the enemies are. A skill listed here skips the plain shake + hit-stop at the cast. holy_nova's smite waits for skillFx.wave.holy_nova.

flask._about: Alchemist's flasks thrown one by one (Flask Barrage, Mystery Brew: a 'flask' event with a named flask): each plays this recipe and its hit waits hitMs (the shatter).

counter._about: Samurai's counter-cut thrown back from far away (Counter Stance): a clang, a crescent flies back, it cuts at hitMs.

wave._about: A channel skill's look PER WAVE: skill id -> recipe in skillFx.js played on the wave's targets (the recipe gets c.wave / c.waves). Replaces the yellow wave ring. shakeMs/shakeIntensity per wave, lastShake* on the final wave; targetShakePx/Ms = the hit enemy itself jitters side to side (user: 'the enemy should be shaking during the shanking').

dash._about: An aggressive dash for a skill (user: 'more aggressive movement'): the hero shoots at its target from wherever it stands (forward = distance to the target minus stopPx, between minPx and maxPx) in inMs, holds, comes back in outMs. At the hit (inMs) the target is knocked back knockPx and the screen shakes (shakeMs, shakeIntensity); 0 = none. Replaces the small lunge for that skill.

name._about: The skill NAME when a hero's skill goes off (user's pick B, 2026-10-18): once, in CAPITALS, over the hero at one fixed pixel size (never scaled): slides up risePx while it fades in, holds, then rises and fades. Colour = the hero's skill colour (heroColors), else defaultColor.

movement._about: Real movement in fights (BattleState.move). Melee walk to their target at walkSpeedPxPerSec until it is inside the reach oval (reachX sideways, reachY up/down), then swing. Fighters closer than the separate oval push apart; a fighter standing still gives way only settledPushShare as much as a walking one, and within wallSoftPx of a side wall it is hardly pushed further towards it; two fighters both standing still drift apart at only settledPairPush of the speed. layout = where the lines stand (also used by tests/bot). BIG fighters (bosses): body size = sprite width / normalBodyPx (at least 1); the push-apart oval grows with the two sizes and a melee fighter can hit a big target from its edge and a big fighter swings from its own edge (reach grows with both sizes), so nobody stands inside a boss. MINIONS always make way for heroes and enemies (never block a hero, never shove an enemy); a fighter bigHoldRatio times bigger than the other (a boss) is not pushed by it.

meleeStep._about: Melee basic attacks step IN to the target (user 2026-10-20: the knight swung at the air). The fighter stands at reach, so on each swing its view moves towards the target (rules position unchanged): it arrives at the hit, holds holdMs, steps back in backMs. Step = distance minus contactPx (x the two body sizes, averaged), at most maxPx. sides: who does it (hero = heroes and minions, enemy).

squadEnter._about: The squad screen's BEGIN DESCENT (SquadScene.descend): the entrance gate opens (floorArt.json door.anim), then the squad waits waitMs before walking in (one after another, staggerMs apart), and the screen fades to black over fadeMs once the last one is through.

bossIntro._about: A boss floor: when the squad is in place the boss ROARS (sound bossRoar): the camera shakes hard (shakeMs, shakeIntensity = share of the screen), a white flash (flashMs), manga ACTION LINES burst from the boss over the whole screen (lines: count, innerPx = empty circle round the boss, widthPx = thickest line end, flickerMs = redrawn this often, alpha, color) and a huge ROAR!! (textPx) slams in; all of it lasts roarMs. The fight starts waitMs after the roar began (BattleScene.bossRoar).

enemyTiers._about: Fodder (enemies.json tier) from fromFloor: health/attack x hpScale/attackScale, floor growth x growthShare (so they stay fodder deep down), XP x xpScale, drawn at drawScale (smaller).

elites._about: Elite enemies (BattleState.makeElite; which floors/how often: dungeons.json director.elites). An elite = health x healthMultiplier, attack x attackMultiplier, +defense/+resist, drawn drawScaleBonus pixel size bigger, XP x xpMultiplier, ONE element + ONE trait (random, equal odds). Element: its hits use damageType (it still walks/shoots like before), onHit statuses, resists/weak added (and removed from the other list), lifesteal %, jumpEvery = every Nth hit also jumps to a second hero (jump.damageMultiplier), onDeath = a cloud like the Puffshroom. Trait: lifesteal %, shieldPercent (of max health, regrows after regrowMs without being hit), thorns % (melee hits), split (dies into count non-elite copies with hpPercent of its max health each, drawn 1 smaller), regenPercentPerSec, statusDurationScale (control statuses), burst (on death: damageMultiplier x its attack as its element's damage on heroes/minions within radius + the element's onHit statuses).
